visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with vibrant purple hair, wearing a dark knit cardigan decorated with embroidered patches over a lime green turtleneck, stands between two white curtains. She pulls the curtains aside with her hands and looks directly into the camera lens with a bright, wide-eyed smile. (2) A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt featuring Snow White graphics stands in a well-lit kitchen. He holds a clear plastic baby bottle and a long-handled white scrub brush, vigorously cleaning the bottle inside a stainless steel sink filled with white soap suds. (3) The purple-haired woman appears again in a medium shot against a neutral white wall background. She gives two enthusiastic thumbs up toward the camera, her facial expression conveying exaggerated joy and approval with an open mouth and raised eyebrows. (4) The man in the kitchen pauses his scrubbing to wipe moisture from his forehead using the upper part of his left arm while maintaining a serious and determined facial expression. He continues to rinse the clear bottle under a running silver faucet. (5) In a tight close-up, the man holds the cleaned bottle up to his right ear. He uses his index finger to rub the interior of the bottle, checking for a physical response while squinting his eyes in deep concentration. (6) The setting shifts to a clean, modern subway station platform with yellow tactile paving. The man, now wearing a green baseball cap, sunglasses, and a backpack, carries two large upright suitcases—one teal and one grey—while walking toward the lens. (7) The man is seen from a high angle as he carries both heavy suitcases up a long flight of grey tiled stairs in the station. His arms are extended fully to his sides as he navigates the steps with a steady, forceful pace. (8) Inside a living room with floor-to-ceiling grey curtains, the purple-haired woman sits cross-legged on a grey sofa reading a book. The man enters the frame carrying several large white shopping bags with prominent blue logos and handles. (9) The man leans over and dumps the contents of multiple shopping bags onto the woman's lap. A pile of diverse clothing items, including dark denim jeans, a light grey sweatshirt, and several graphic t-shirts, quickly covers her lap and the surrounding sofa. (10) Outdoors in a public plaza, a massive white and blue robotic statue stands in the background. The man, wearing a striped scarf and a cream-colored t-shirt, stands in front of the camera holding a large pink tote bag. (11) The man reaches into the pink tote bag and pulls out a brown and cream scarf, which he carefully wraps around the woman's neck. She smiles broadly as he continues to rummage through the bag's contents to reveal more hidden items. (12) The man proceeds to pull out a silver vacuum-insulated flask, a clear bottle of water with a blue label, a small blue tub of ice cream, and a purple coffee cup sleeve with an attached character doll. He displays each item proudly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bright, high-frequency synthesizer melody that sets a high-arousal, comedic tone. A woman's voice briefly exclaims in a high pitch, followed immediately by a sharp, synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect that indicates a visual scene transition. (2) A male narrator with a professional yet animated tone begins speaking at a fast pace. The background music maintains a strong, 4/4 electronic beat at approximately 128 BPM. A metallic 'ding' sound effect punctuates his first sentence to emphasize a comedic point. (3) A distinct, high-pitched friction sound, resembling a 'squeak,' is heard three times in rapid succession. The narrator's speech becomes more rhythmic, almost matching the tempo of the background music. There is no audible environmental noise, suggesting a highly post-produced studio master. (4) As the man moves to carry heavy bags, a loud 'thud' and the rustling of plastic are simulated through a stylized 'impact' sound effect. The BGM gains more low-end bass energy to reflect the physical effort described in the narration. (5) A series of 'sparkle' and 'pop' SFX are triggered every two seconds as items are presented. The narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability and rising intonations, conveying excitement and playfulness while the percussive pop track continues at a consistent volume. (6) The video concludes with a rising musical stinger that reaches a peak frequency before a final, enunciated call-to-action by the male narrator. The audio is cleanly cut to silence at the exact moment the visual frame ends.
